proof_body:
by
  intro f f1 f2 a x hf hf1 h2
  have hm : Monotone f1 := by
    apply monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun y => (hf1 y).differentiableAt)
    intro y
    rw [(hf1 y).deriv]
    exact h2 y
  have hc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (hf y).continuousAt
  rcases lt_trichotomy x a with h | rfl | h
  · obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f f1 h hc.continuousOn (fun y _ => hf y)
    have hle : f1 c ≤ f1 a := hm hc1.2.le
    have hpos : 0 < a - x := by linarith
    rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne'] at hc2
    nlinarith
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f f1 h hc.continuousOn (fun y _ => hf y)
    have hle : f1 a ≤ f1 c := hm hc1.1.le
    have hpos : 0 < x - a := by linarith
    rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne'] at hc2
    nlinarith
target_source: ∀ (f f1 f2 : ℝ → ℝ) (a x : ℝ), (∀ y, HasDerivAt f (f1 y) y) → (∀ y, HasDerivAt f1 (f2 y) y) → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f2 y) → f a + f1 a * (x - a) ≤ f x
